findings.assessment: Original UID/GID/RequireUnprivilegedInitialNamespace guard expression is unchanged. On failure original_error is captured before diagnostics; the function restores incoming errno and existing Fd reset/destructors preserve it. r.Fail(1, original_error) remains the result. No success branch is changed; default main returns PLAN_ONLY before Run.

New self PIDFD_THREAD and returned userns fd are held in local noncopyable Fd objects and closed in reverse order on every normal return. Only getresuid/getresgid, invalid-UID/GID fsid queries, capget for current thread, PR_GET_DUMPABLE/SECCOMP/NO_NEW_PRIVS/SECUREBITS, same-thread pidfd open, namespace query and metadata reads occur. There is no setns/unshare/credential change/service connection in the new function.

Diagnostic data are numeric values in a 4096-byte preallocated buffer. snprintf result is checked; overflow/error becomes a fixed valid JSON object. Default field is null. Failed substeps retain explicit rc/errno or unattempted -99 values, so zeroed metadata are not unconditionally labeled valid. Actual local Print output parsed as JSON.

All four packet texts, lengths and SHA256 values match on-disk files and stage EXPECTED. Request stdin exactly equals packet bytes; launcher pins complete packet and entry before compile/exec. Entry is python -I, create-only fixed source03/out03, original operator only; actual candidate05 receipt/manifest/compiler validation precedes source directory creation. Stage AST equals reviewed02 after only fixed paths/labels and EXPECTED normalization.

Actual diff leaves candidate05 948/925 source inventory, actual source and matched-gate pins, exact 291 dependency cardinality, MD equality, source before/after checks, 21 compile/link/audit commands and worker closure admission unchanged. Only fresh source03/out03 paths, previous-build02 reference and failure-diagnostic descriptive field change. This review does not prove new 291 closure or complete build will succeed; those gates must actually run.

qualified_limits: Diagnostic also runs after the original UID/GID short-circuit rejection. Its JSON accurately says original_guard_failure; consumers must not infer RequireUnprivilegedInitialNamespace was reached for every failure.
Observed credential/namespace values are sampled after the original guard failure; they do not prove every original substep saw identical state or by themselves establish a production root cause.

The actual local function control includes exact client source and calls DiagnoseInitialNamespace/Print directly with preexisting stage1/EIO; it does not run full Run(), production namespace guard, full factory/client protocol, Bionic, Android, or any Main action.

No packet mutation, source/out staging, execute-once, remote request, full build, service start, namespace entry, or complete fixture runtime was performed by reviewer. Parent owns any later build/runtime admission.
